top_risk_drivers: Zero executable test coverage over the entire business-rules engine, and this is structurally proven (no <ProjectReference> from GildedRose.Tests to GildedRose.Console), not merely an unmeasured gap.

The application's only business logic, UpdateQuality (src/GildedRose.Console/Program.cs:37-111), is a single 75-line method with 5 levels of nested conditionals, 8 item-name magic-string comparisons, and 4 duplicated quality-increment blocks — no seam exists to test or safely modify it.

Both projects target .NET Framework 4.5 / 4.5.1, past Microsoft end-of-support, with no in-place path onto the FAA profile's AWS GovCloud / Amazon ECS-on-Fargate substrate (profiles/faa/config/common.yaml) without a full runtime port.

The build chain is non-hermetic and internet-dependent: build.bat downloads an unpinned NuGet.exe over HTTPS and restores from the deprecated nuget.org v2 feed (NuGet.config:7), and tasks.ps1 imports its Clean/Build/Test/Version task bodies from an out-of-repo psake.net 0.1.3 package not present in this workspace.

No SCA tool output or vulnerability database was supplied as an input to this assessment, so the 12 distinct NuGet package dependencies (several pinned to 2014-era versions) are UNASSESSED for known CVEs — this is a measurement gap, not a clean bill of health, and must not be read as 'no vulnerabilities found'.

GOVERNING-PROFILE / APPLICATION-IDENTITY DISCREPANCY (recorded per this task's binding instruction, not adopted as fact): the governing profile for this assessment is authoritatively `faa`, but the source tree is the publicly published, generic 'Gilded Rose Refactoring Kata' with no aviation/NAS/FAA content, and Pass 1 (structural-analysis.json open_questions[0]) separately observed a conflicting `AssemblyCompany("DSHS")`/`Copyright "DSHS 2015"` attribution embedded in the shipped assembly metadata. Whether application_id d634afdb-97cc-4589-a080-5766d4f377d5 genuinely maps to an FAA-owned system is unconfirmed, which bears directly on whether the FAA-specific weighting used in this assessment (profiles/faa/scoring.yaml) is the correct lens at all.

highest_risk_modules.reason: The entire application (160 of 172 LOC): hosts the process entry point, the seed data, the complete business-rules engine, and the domain model in one file/class/namespace, with 0% proven test coverage and the EOL runtime dependency.
Structurally disconnected from production code (no <ProjectReference>, one tautological Assert.True(true) test) — the risk it carries is the false impression of a safety net where none exists.

per_module.note: All measured debt is concentrated here; this module is effectively the entire application.
Test-scaffold module carries no production logic. Its contribution to debt is captured as the coverage gap on gildedrose-console (zero exercised production code), not as an independent module score.

contributing_factors.smell_density: 18 weighted code-smell occurrences (sum of code_smells[].count for QR-001..QR-008 below) inside the gildedrose-console module (160 LOC per structural-analysis.json modules[0].loc) => normalized score = round(100 * 18 / 25) = 72/100. 25 weighted occurrences was chosen as the saturation point because a per-KLOC formula is unstable at this module's tiny size (160 LOC).
contributing_factors.coverage_gap: test_coverage.gap_to_baseline_pct = 80 (0% measured line coverage vs the profile's 80% default baseline) used directly as the 0-100 gap score.
contributing_factors.vulnerability_count: EXCLUDED from the weighted sum: measurement.method = unavailable — no SCA tool or vulnerability-database output was supplied as an input to this assessment. Treating an unmeasured input as 0 would misreport an unknown as a clean result, so its weight is dropped rather than defaulted to zero.
contributing_factors.churn_rate: EXCLUDED from the weighted sum: measurement.method = unavailable — the repository's history is a single commit ('Update README.md', no remote configured; structural-analysis.json open_questions[6]), which cannot support a commits/quarter figure.
contributing_factors.weighting: Default full-input weights per the rubric are smell_density 0.35, coverage_gap 0.35, vulnerability_count 0.15, churn_rate 0.15 (summing to 1.0). With the latter two unavailable, their combined 0.30 weight is redistributed proportionally across the two measured inputs, giving smell_density 0.50 and coverage_gap 0.50.
contributing_factors.score_formula: score = round(0.50 * smell_density_score + 0.50 * coverage_gap_score) = round(0.50*72 + 0.50*80) = round(76.0) = 76
contributing_factors.band_thresholds: Assessor-defined default (no FAA-profile-specific debt-band thresholds were found in profiles/faa/scoring.yaml or profiles/faa/risk-classification.yaml): 0-25 low, 26-50 moderate, 51-80 high, 81-100 critical.

measurement.notes: Derived by hand from Pass 1's structural map plus a direct re-read of src/GildedRose.Console/Program.cs; no automated debt-scoring tool was run. Confidence is medium rather than high because two of the rubric's four inputs (vulnerability_count, churn_rate) are unmeasured and the smell-density normalization constant (25) is an assessor judgment call, stated explicitly in contributing_factors so a reviewer can substitute their own constant and rerun the math.

gildedrose-console.note: Sole production module. No statement or branch in Program.cs/UpdateQuality can execute under the current test suite (see measurement.notes).

gildedrose-tests.note: The test harness itself; not a coverage target. Contains 1 test method (TestTheTruth), which asserts Assert.True(true) and calls no production code.

measurement.notes: No coverage tool or CI-emitted coverage report exists for this application (primary_technology.ci_cd = [] in structural-analysis.json; no CI/CD config found in the repository). 0% is not a fabricated default: GildedRose.Tests.csproj declares zero <ProjectReference> to GildedRose.Console (confirmed by direct read of src/GildedRose.Tests/GildedRose.Tests.csproj:42-58 and a repo-wide grep for ProjectReference returning nothing), so the single test method at src/GildedRose.Tests/TestAssemblyTests.cs:7-11 (Assert.True(true)) is mechanically incapable of executing any statement in the production assembly. Line and branch coverage of gildedrose-console are therefore 0% by structural proof, which is the 'measurement unavailable' vs 'measurement = zero' distinction resolved in favor of a provable zero. gap_to_baseline_pct uses the profile's stated 80% default baseline; this application's risk_classification.yaml tier is unconfirmed (application-catalog-entry.md safety_tier = null), so the tier-specific 90%/80%/80% baselines in profiles/faa/risk-classification.yaml could not be selected between and the skill's stated 80% default was used instead.
